Additions/rewrites/omissions: none.

Observations (not verdicts):
1. final_month_renewal_credit_on_package_fee: "It is subtracted as well as any other credit on the line" — renders the source's "is subtracted as well" generically; it names no factor or document and does not change the assembly (reduced fee less both credits, floored). Recorded for visibility; not judged a pointer.
2. billing_calendar_and_occupancy_settings: "Proration on every program is by the actual days in the month" renders the still-live `proration_method` parameter; the final package fee's 30-day convention is pinned specifically in final_package_fee_proration_method and the partial-month clause is shown as retired in flat_and_package_lines, so entailment is unaffected. Policy-side note: the parameter is kept unqualified while the overwrite narrows where it applies.

Policy-side notes: (a) the baseline sentence "In the standard case nothing is left to the security deposit …" is source text of the baseline rule and is rendered as such; its phrase "in the standard case" implies non-standard cases, which the render skill would otherwise keep out of a computation document — a source matter, not a KB verdict. (b) The overage clause is retired whole (water, gas and electricity), while the replacements cover only the final water and electricity overage lines; gas overage and non-final overage lines keep no pricing clause in force. The KB retires exactly what is declared.
